---
title: "Kahoot"
---


```{r}
tibble::tribble(
  ~a, ~b,
  "1/1/2025 11:30am", "2/1/2025 12:30pm") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(a = lubridate::mdy_hm(a), b = lubridate::mdy_hm(b)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(d = b - a) |> 
  str()
```


```{r}
tibble::tribble(
  ~a, ~b,
  "C", "A",
  "B", "B",
  "A", "C") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(c = a, d = b) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(a = factor(a), b = factor(b),
                c = forcats::fct(c), d = forcats::fct(d)) |> 
  str()
```
